about_the_game:
Death Kitchen is a fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers. Mistakes are fatal. Meet the quota and move on to the next day or suffer the consequences. 

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Gather your friends then connect using built-in direct messaging. Play solo or with up to 4 friends and start your intergalactic food chain empire! TIME TO BE RICH!

TEAM FORMATION

One manager and 4 other morphing creatures. Manager is in charge of morphing decisions. CHANGE IS KEY. ADAPTABILITY IS SUCCESS. 

MORPHING CREATURES

You can turn into most things in the kitchen! Need to cut a lot? Morph into a knife! Is the restaurant too dark? Morph into a lightbulb! NO LIMITATION FOR CREATIVITY.

COOKING FEATURES

Some stations in your kitchen have mini-games! Others are realistic cooking. LET THEM COOK.

AGGRESSIVE ALIEN CUSTOMERS

All customers are unique and have a lot to learn about! Make sure you serve them before they run out of patience and not mess up their order. OTHERWISE DEATH.

PROXIMITY CHAT

Built-in proximity voice and text chat to enhance your immersive experience. Hear your teammate screaming? THAT’S NOT GOOD!

RANDOM EVENTS

The new planets are not as stable as Earth. Ingredient shortages? Power outage? Customer rush? Buy items from the shop and take advantage of morphing to survive! CHAOS

INCOMING. MANY NEW WILD PLANETS AWAIT.

Every planet has different unique traits and ingredients. Some of them will definitely blow your mind! ARE YOU READY TO TAKE ON THE CHALLENGE?

  • Online multiplayer integration using Unity Gaming Services

  • Proximity voice and text chat while in game

  • Lobby voice and text chat while in menu

  • Invite your friends to your party!

  • Direct Messaging features pre-built into the main menu.

  • Unity cloud save enabled!

  • Multiple customization options for your player and your restaurant

  • DLCs to be released at a later date

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i7 or Ryzen 7 equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce RTX 2060

short_description: Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. You can morph into a variety of characters! Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.
